extension.summary: Install KingBlap Kodi builds across Kodi-supported platforms.
extension.description: Shows separate public and private KingBlap build choices for Kodi 21 Omega and Kodi 22 Piers. Kodi 21.3 and Kodi 22 public builds download directly from the public repository with SHA-256 verification; private builds download from the KingBlap service and require the saved 16-digit access code. Public builds may include the owner-authorized IPTV Simple playlist and guide URLs; those URLs contain credentials and are accessible to anyone downloading the public archive. Saved personal add-on profiles are omitted from public builds, while bundled add-on API defaults from the supplied backup are publicly readable. Before downloading or unpacking, the Wizard checks that Kodi has enough free storage and stops with a clear message when the device needs space. It installs packaged add-ons, verifies every packaged add-on is enabled, restores IPTV Simple settings, explicitly enables and verifies the PVR client, and asks Kodi to install device-compatible native dependencies, sets Gismeteo for Thomasville, removes duplicate legacy installers, OnePlay, and private-build OptiKlean, and applies the compatible Xonfluence skin. Private builds can select a packaged screensaver or Kodi's built-in dim screensaver. Private GIPTV builds keep only USA and 24/7 playlist groups and stream a filtered guide for those channels. Their TV Channels window opens in Xonfluence Preview List. Private builds can apply a low-memory streaming-buffer limit and remove legacy add-ons they replace. It checks active skin files before preserving them and restores incomplete skin files during installation. Interrupted installs are recovered safely when Kodi starts again. Private builds can set Kodi to install compatible add-on updates automatically from enabled repositories.
extension.disclaimer: Some public builds include the owner's authorized IPTV Simple playlist and guide URLs. These URLs contain credentials, and bundled add-on API defaults are also visible to anyone who downloads the public archive. Private builds may also include service credentials in add-on profile data and require a shared access code. Review the selected build before installing it.
